cards.name: Raiding Parties
cards.text: Every player loses a node or pays 10 credits (never their last node).
cards.value: absorbs 4 a player (8 to drain); harm a node (6) or 10 credits, the player's pick: 6-10, about 8 a player; 1.5-2.5, about 2.0 a compute
cards.check: the first project to fill, rounds 2-4; each player picks the cheaper half, so it never strands a seat; no loop

cards.name: War Footing
cards.text: Every corp base fills to its troop cap now. Sway 1 toward Discord.

effects.why: corp bases make corp troops (more war, more Discord); fill: each base makes troops up to its cap, once, now

cards.value: absorbs 7 a player (14 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + 2-4 troops a country at 5 (10-20) + 1 sway (4) = 14-24, about 19; 2.0-3.4, about 2.7 a compute
cards.check: bites rounds 3-6, worth most when bases are well under cap after a war; capped by the troop cap, once; the answer is draining it or a strong war seat; no loop
flags: new op corp_troops (fill field; past_cap false, since a fill stops at the cap by definition)
troops a base is short of its cap is a guess until a read

cards.name: Purge the Unaligned
cards.text: Every player loses an ambassador or a node (never their last node). 1 troop lands on a factory in each country.
cards.value: absorbs 7 a player (14 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 4-6 (ambassador or node, their pick) + a troop and its strike (about 10) = 14-16; 2.0-2.3 a compute
cards.check: mid-game, rounds 4-7; the troop is answered like any landing; the loss is everyone's pick, so it never strands a seat

cards.name: Armored Columns
cards.text: In each country, 2 troops land on factories.
cards.value: absorbs 10 a player (20 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + 2 troops and their strikes (about 20) = 20; 2.0 a compute
cards.check: rounds 5-8; Security removals (5 a troop) and Wall answer it; troops march on, capped by the troop supply

cards.name: Arms Race
cards.text: Ongoing: each round, every military base makes 1 more troop.

effects.why: corp bases make extra corp troops (more war, more Discord): every base, each production step, past its cap

cards.value: absorbs 11 a player (22 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + 1 troop (5) a base a round, 1-2 bases a country, 3-4 rounds = 15-40, about 27; 1.4-3.6, about 2.5 a compute
cards.check: lands rounds 5-7 and runs to the end; strong war seats fight the troops; past the cap, so capped by bases (fixed by the board) and the troop supply, not a loop
flags: unsure: value swings with bases a country; may want cost 12-13 at 1 country

cards.name: Declaration of War
cards.text: In each country, 2 troops land on factories. Ongoing: each round, the front with the most corp troops fights twice.

effects.why: each round the war step runs twice on the front with the most corp troops (a second round of cancelling and factory strikes): live even when every round is a war round

cards.value: absorbs 18 a player (36 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + 2 troops and their strikes now (about 20) + a second war step on one front (about 12) a round for 1-3 rounds (12-36) = 32-56, about 44; 1.8-3.1, about 2.4 a compute (the second war step is one front table-wide, so it thins at 2+ countries)
cards.check: the military superproject: only fills rounds 7-10, when every round is already a war round, so the second war step is what bites; game-shaping, not a loss: a war seat on that front holds it, and draining 36 a player stops it; one extra step a round, no loop
flags: new op extra_war (ongoing form; front field: the one with the most corp troops, ties unsettled)
an ongoing project acting in the war step: today ongoing projects act only in the build step
135: the troops are its `resolve` line (once, when it resolves); its `effects` act every round while it stands

cards.name: Disinformation
cards.text: Sway 4 toward Discord. Every player loses an ambassador.
cards.value: absorbs 5 a player (10 to drain); harm 16 to the table plus 4 a player: about 12 a player at 2 players, 8 at 4; 1.6-2.4 a compute
cards.check: cheap, fills rounds 2-4; nobody counters a project, so the answer is draining it; no loop
flags: sway doesn't scale with players while cost does: dearer per compute at 4 players

cards.name: Recruitment Drive
cards.text: Ongoing: every round, each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered clean cities.
cards.value: absorbs 11 a player (22 to drain); harm 1-2 clean cities a country mid-game, 5 each, 3-4 rounds: 15-40; 1.4-3.6, about 2.5 a compute
cards.check: lands rounds 5-7; aligning cities shrinks it, so an Influence engine answers it; capped by clean cities, which only fall

cards.name: Infiltration Drive
cards.text: Corrupt cities (1 fewer).
cards.value: absorbs 18 a player (36 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + a city corrupted (45, the liberation price, which covers the nodes next to it destroyed, the player ambassadors waiting on it lost, its energy swaying Discord and its build after) = 45; 2.5 a compute
cards.check: the influence superproject, rounds 7-10; one city a country is a blow, not a loss: corrupting it destroys the nodes next to it and loses the player ambassadors waiting there; liberation answers it; corrupted cities build, capped by city_build

cards.name: Data Heist
cards.text: Every player loses 3 tokens from their cards and gets 2 less insight next round.
cards.value: absorbs 6 a player (12 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 3 tokens (about 6) + 2 insight (8) + 0 = 14; 2.3 a compute
cards.check: rounds 2-5, when token engines start; draining it is the answer; no loop

cards.name: Botnet Swarm
cards.text: Each board: create 2 adversary ambassadors on each of the 2 lowest-numbered botnet hexes.
cards.value: absorbs 6 a player (12 to drain); harm 1-2 botnets a country, 2 ambassadors each at 5: 10-20; 1.7-3.3 a compute
cards.check: rounds 3-6; removing botnets (tier-2 Cyber) shrinks it; the ambassadors spread and can make more botnets, capped by spread rules and supply

cards.name: Station Coup
cards.text: In each country, a research station is corrupted. A player's holds unless 2 adversary and no player ambassadors are on it: an adversary ambassador lands.
cards.value: absorbs 9 a player (18 to drain); harm a corrupted station (20) a country; 2.2 a compute
cards.check: rounds 5-8; a player ambassador on an owned station guards it; cleanse answers it; no loop
flags: text is 131 characters, over 130, to keep today's guard rule

cards.name: Market Crash
cards.text: Every player gets 6 fewer credits of income next round and loses all their chips.

effects.why: lose_insight's twin for credits (as tier-1 Credit Crunch): income lost next round
players_lose gains an 'all' field: every one held

cards.value: absorbs 5 a player (10 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 6 credits + 0-3 chips at 3 (0-9) + 0 = 6-15, about 12; 1.2-3.0, about 2.4 a compute
cards.check: rounds 2-5, while 6 is a third of a round's income; worst for a seat banking chips for a build; nobody answers it but by draining; no loop
flags: new op lose_income (shared with tier-1 Credit Crunch)
chips lost has no harm row of its own: listed under credits or income lost

cards.name: Shadow Factories
cards.text: The adversary builds a factory in the country with the most free industrial zones. None: 2 of its ambassadors land on a factory.

effects.why: the adversary takes one free industrial zone with its own factory, in the country with the most free zones (ties, the lower hex)

cards.value: absorbs 7 a player (14 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + an adversary factory (15: it makes an adversary troop on its hex each production step) + its zone blocked 1-2 rounds it would have been claimed (6-12) = 15-27, about 21; 2.1-3.9, about 3.0 a compute (one factory table-wide, so dearer per compute at 2+ countries)
cards.check: rounds 3-6, while zones are free; Industry seats that claim zones early blunt it; the factory makes an adversary troop on its hex each production step, and with no removal it stays to the end; one factory a fill, no loop
flags: an adversary factory has no removal route in today's rules: a later rules item must add one (as liberation is for a city)

cards.name: Capital Flight
cards.text: Every player's income falls by 4 credits for the rest of the game.
cards.value: absorbs 8 a player (16 to drain); harm 4 a round for 4-5 rounds: 16-20 a player; 2.0-2.5 a compute
cards.check: rounds 4-6; worth less the later it lands; nobody answers it but by draining; no loop
flags: team_income with a negative amount: the engine may refuse it (a one-line check, not a new op)

cards.name: Rolling Blackouts
cards.text: Next round, cities make no energy and research stations make no research cubes.

effects.name: station_dark
effects.why: a station makes no research cubes for a round

cards.value: absorbs 6 a player (12 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): about 2 energy (9) + a cube (6) + 0 = 15; 2.5 a compute
cards.check: rounds 2-5, worst for a Science seat; one round only; no loop
flags: new flag station_dark (a rule must read it)
the blackout flag over every country, not one

cards.name: Grid Capture
cards.text: Ongoing: every round, every player loses 1 energy.
cards.value: absorbs 9 a player (18 to drain); harm 4.5 a round for 4 rounds: 18 a player; 2.0 a compute
cards.check: lands rounds 4-6; it acts in the build step, so it takes from energy held into the round; a player with none loses none; no loop

cards.name: False Flag
cards.text: Deal 1 extra tier-2 threat in each country, any tag.

effects.why: deal_threats gains tier and each_country fields: one tier-2 threat dealt into each country now, executing next round

cards.value: absorbs 6 a player (12 to drain); harm a tier-2 threat a country: the cheaper of its counter (9-12) or its harm uncountered (about 15-20) = 9-12, 1.5-2.0 a compute; 2.5-3.3 a compute where nobody near it pays
cards.check: rounds 3-6; countered like any threat by players near it; no loop: threats give compute, but a threat doesn't deal a project
flags: deal_threats gains tier and each_country fields (today: count, one per country in turn)

cards.name: Grand Offensive
cards.text: The adversary builds now, then Corrupt cities; sway 2 toward Discord.
cards.value: absorbs 10 a player (20 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + 15-25 of build and spread + 2 sway (8) = 23-33; 2.3-3.3, about 2.8 a compute
cards.check: rounds 5-8, when corrupted cities build 2 each; ongoing projects don't act in it; no loop

cards.name: Propaganda Network
cards.text: Ongoing: every round, sway 2 toward Discord, remove 1 Unity from the Unity track. Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on the lowest-numbered corrupted city.
cards.value: absorbs 14 a player (28 to drain); harm a round: 2 sway (8) + 1 Unity pull (4) = 12 to the table, about 4 a player at 3 players, + corrupted cities' extra build (about 7 a country) = about 11, for 3 rounds = about 33; 2.4 a compute
cards.check: the universal superproject, rounds 7-10; liberating cities shrinks it; city_build feeds corruption, capped by the deck's last rounds
flags: the city_build twist read every round from an ongoing project: the engine reads it only off the current adversary card
